segments.text: The protagonist of this game, she hid the fact she's a girl and enrolled into Univers Theater School. Her elder brother is Tachibana Tsuki, a genius actor. Kisa has the hidden potential to play both Jack (male) and Jeanne (female) roles. For the sake of her dreams and also to secure victory for her class, the Quartz group, Kisa takes her place on stage as a "cog" that moves everyone's hearts.

Due to his showy nature and dancing ability, Sarafumi is an Al Jeanne; a star among other Jeannes that take on main roles. As such, he's seen as the face of his class, the Quartz group. He hates stuffy formalities and is always lighthearted but at the same time, he has a sharp intuition and observes people closely. During his first year, he joined forces with Univers' legendary Tachibana Tsuki and they shone brightly upon stage. That experience is now a darkness growing in his heart.

Notable even among other Jacks, Kai is a Jack Ace; a Jack that plays main roles. He is in a pair with Takashina Sarafumi and Kai acts as a "vase" to support the "flower" of the stage, Sarafumi. He's taciturn and likes his alone time but he's always watching over his Quartz class and his kindness can be seen in how he helps fellow students in need. It seems that Kai's always thinking about what he can do as a Jack Ace.

The leader of the Quartz class. Kokuto is a genius that can not only competently play both Jack and Jeanne roles but also directs and writes the scripts of the Quartz class' shows. He's eccentric and in order to create amazing productions, he often subjects the Quartz students to his unconventional ways. The way he doesn't put his genius to waste and throws himself into his duties sometimes seems reckless.

As he looks like a young girl and has a high singing voice, Mitsuki is a Jeanne and the Quartz class' "songstress". He doesn't think much of acting or dancing but when it comes to his specialty- singing- he works hard and doesn't cut corners. Individualistic, he doesn't show interest in others but his guidance is always precise. It remains to be seen how Mitsuki, a second-year, will get involved with the protagonist and her fellow first-years.

Kisa's classmate, Suzu is a Jack that whose cheerful disposition draws attention from others. Suzu decided to enroll into Univers Theater School due to his admiration of the legendary Jack Ace, Tachibana Tsuki. The life of his class, he can strike up a conversation with anybody without fear or shyness. He does have a tactless side to him but he works arduously everyday to become a Jack Ace like Tachibana Tsuki.

Kisa's classmate who originally enrolled with the intention to be a Jack but was selected as a Jeanne. He's also Kisa's childhood friend and when they were kids, along with Kisa's older brother Tsuki, the three played together, pretending to be theater actors. Soushirou is completely aware of the circumstances surrounding Kisa's enrollment and that she's a girl. He has strong feelings about theater but struggles to express them and as such, often hides in Kisa's shadow agonizing over them.
